policy_scope: Frozen axes-first format-only reviewer runs and their recombined answers; not a quality validation of newly changed decoder outputs.

claim_breakdown.origin_denominators: Unique human IDs may appear in multiple origins; occurrence subsets are disjoint, unique origin counts need not sum to the global unique count.

paired_completeness.interpretation: No paired labeled loss is not proof that either answer is complete.

reviewer_native_speed.scope: native reviewer generation calls on identical frozen prompt/token inputs; load, draft generation, retrieval/network and end-to-end latency excluded

interpretation: All 30 factual_support labels are human-supported; the5 bad protocol claims fail comparison alignment, not factual source support as annotated.
Human-uncertain comparison remains separate and is not relabeled as a false fact.
A passed relative-recall or speed gate does not override safety/usability failure.
The formal paired-completeness gate had zero adequate 9B answers; its pass is not evidence of adequate completeness.
Both models are predictions; 9B is not ground truth. Two questions, six correlated contexts and one annotator do not establish general superiority or equivalence.
The user selected 4B for continuing development despite these recorded research limitations.
